headline: Claim Drew Lock (bid 7, drop Malik Willis) before Wed 12:05 AM PT — he's confirmed to start for Seattle with Darnold out, and it fixes your week 6 Burrow/Willis bye clash.
summary: Danny's 1-0 lineup is otherwise set right for week 2: no starters carry an injury flag, so no auto-subs are needed. The one lineup fix left on the board is moving MarShawn Lloyd into FLEX over Tre Tucker — Lloyd is Green Bay's clear starter with Josh Jacobs out on the exempt list. A.J. Brown stays on IR; new reporting puts his ankle timeline at 6-plus weeks.

lineup.why: Lloyd is Green Bay's clear early-down back with Josh Jacobs on the exempt list into at least mid-November, projected for 10.7 carries plus 2.5 targets against Tucker's 5.3 targets in an offense built around Ashton Jeanty.
lineup.evidence: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said Lloyd is 'as ready as he's ever been' with no injury designation in Sept 2-14 practice reports, and Jacobs' legal case (initial court appearance Nov 17) keeps him out well beyond this week; Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said the offense runs through Jeanty until Brock Bowers returns, capping Tucker's target share after a 4-target Week 1 (Sept 2026 reports).

adds.why: tier 2, bid 7 of your 145: a confirmed short-term starter with a bye (11) that fixes your Burrow/Willis week 6 clash, priced low because Darnold's injury is being called a bruise, not a fracture, so the job may not last.
adds.evidence: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said his early read is Lock starts Week 2 at Arizona with Darnold out (Sept 14-15 reports); Darnold's hip X-rays were negative for a fracture and it's described as 'more of a muscle thing,' so Lock's hold on the job is not guaranteed to last; Willis remains Miami's own QB1 but is Danny's bench QB3 with no path to starts here.

flags.what: IR, high-ankle sprain from Sept 9; reported Sept 10-13 to be out at least 6 weeks, likely into mid-October.
TB's 1B receiving-down back behind Bucky Irving, not a lead-back role (Sept 2026 reports).
GB's clear starter with Jacobs on the exempt list past Nov 17; no injury concern as of Sept 14 practice.
Buffalo's WR2, plays Thu 5:15 PM vs DET; no injury designation as of Sept 15.
Miami's own QB1, but Danny's bench QB3; recommended drop for Drew Lock this week.

watch.what: Hip injury is being called minor (no fracture); if he's cleared soon, Lock's run as starter could be short — don't chase Lock's price beyond a low bid.
GB's other back behind Lloyd getting early-down snaps too; watch his share if Lloyd's workload comes in light.

alerts.title: ➕ Claim Drew Lock, drop Willis
alerts.body: Lock starts for Seattle with Darnold out; bid 7, drop Malik Willis, before the Wed 12:05 AM PT waiver run — fixes your week 6 QB bye clash.

alerts.title: 🔁 Start Lloyd over Tucker in FLEX
alerts.body: MarShawn Lloyd is Green Bay's clear starter with Jacobs on the exempt list; move him into FLEX over Tre Tucker before Sunday's 10 AM PT kickoffs.

alerts.title: 🔴 A.J. Brown out 6+ weeks
alerts.body: New reporting says Brown's high-ankle sprain keeps him out at least 6 weeks, into mid-October; he stays on IR, no action needed.
